04597 Ma`ai {maw-ah'-ee}

可能源自 04578; 陽性專有名詞

欽定本 - Maai 1; 1

瑪艾 = "慈悲的"
1) 亞薩眾子之一。耶路撒冷城牆告成的時候，參與音樂的服事  (#尼 12:36|)
record.edic_text:
04597 Ma`ai {maw-ah'-ee}

probably from 04578;; n pr m

AV - Maai 1; 1

Maai = "compassionate"
1) one of the sons of Asaph who took part in the musical service at
   the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem
